description: Jason is pulled from the modern world into Atlantis and falls in with Pythagoras and Hercules, whose attempts to survive the city's myths and politics repeatedly draw them toward Ariadne, Pasiphae and the secrets surrounding Jason's arrival. Monsters, curses and palace intrigue gradually make it clear that Jason's connection to Atlantis is much deeper than chance.

s01e01.description: Searching for answers about his missing father, Jason is transported to Atlantis, where new friends Pythagoras and Hercules help him survive a deadly ritual involving the Minotaur.

s01e02.description: Jason, Hercules and Pythagoras search for an abducted woman and encounter the Maenads, while their rescue introduces them to Medusa.

s01e03.description: After offending a powerful nobleman, Jason is forced into the dangerous spectacle of bull-leaping and must rely on an unlikely group of fellow prisoners.

s01e04.description: The trio's attempt to protect an abandoned baby draws them into a secret that reaches uncomfortably close to the royal household.

s01e05.description: Ariadne asks Jason to help her meet her exiled brother Therus, whose account of the past casts Pasiphae's role in his banishment in a darker light.

s01e06.description: Hercules turns to Circe for magical help in winning Medusa's affection, leaving Jason and Pythagoras to deal with the dangerous consequences of the enchantment.

s01e07.description: With Ariadne expected to marry Heptarian, Jason enters a brutal fighting tournament and finds himself competing for far more than victory in the arena.

s01e08.description: A journey with Pythagoras's brother Arcas leads the group into a temple of the Furies, where buried guilt and family secrets become impossible to contain.

s01e09.description: When Medusa is kidnapped, Hercules is driven into a dangerous quest for an underworld artifact whose recovery brings consequences none of them anticipate.

s01e10.description: Hercules refuses to abandon the cursed Medusa, sending the friends in search of Daedalus and a possible cure while enemies close in around them.

s01e11.description: Jason eats an enchanted feast and begins undergoing a disturbing transformation, forcing Hercules and Pythagoras to discover what has happened before it becomes irreversible.

s01e12.description: Circe demands that Jason kill Pasiphae, pushing him and his friends into a dangerous infiltration of the palace as the struggle around Ariadne intensifies.

s01e13.description: With Minos weakened and Pasiphae moving against Ariadne, Jason risks everything to protect the princess and learns a revelation that changes what he understands about his own past.
